title: The server’s own products
description: Roles members can buy (even time-limited, e.g. a 7-day VIP) and collectible items. Purchases are atomic: the bot only takes the money if it could actually assign the role.
dialogText: Members can buy it with the /shop command.
keyHint: e.g. vip — this is what /shop buy asks for
name: Name
roleHint: Only non-integration roles below the bot’s role can be sold
emptyText: Sell a role (even a 7-day VIP) or a collectible item for the server’s currency.
deleteText: The product is removed from the shop. Copies and roles already bought are kept.
builtin: Built-in items ({count}) — available on every server, can’t be edited
